title: Exact evidence navigation from the saved heat comparison
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Heat-spreader comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved heat-spreader workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Open saved comparison
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved heat comparison workspace link. On revision_60_fine click Open representation, Open assessment, then Open producing step, reopening the comparison between actions.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the heat workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted heat workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted heat workflow is listed.

steps.label: Heat workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original heat assignment opens with its connected review, CAD and analysis stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted heat workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved heat source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual heat run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded heat run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Reopen saved comparison
steps.summary: The saved revised comparison reads all actual heat results in a Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Reuse compiled saved assets without regeneration.
steps.action: Open the recorded saved-interface workspace link.
steps.expected: Saved comparison connects and exposes all eighteen actual results.
steps.actual: Saved interface connected and eighteen actual results visible.

steps.label: Exact fine-field evidence opens
steps.summary: The comparison opens the actual fine-grid temperature table through Wright’s common evidence view.
steps.purpose: Verify authorized evidence navigation from the generated interface.
steps.expected: Native common view shows the exact numerical CSV.
steps.actual: Actual numerical table and temperature column opened from the tailored interface.

steps.label: All recorded field samples
steps.summary: The evidence viewer renders all 765 supplied samples using explicitly selected axes.
steps.purpose: Inspect actual solver outputs from the saved UI.
steps.action: Expand View numerical samples and select x_m, y_m, temperature_c.

steps.label: Exact held assessment opens
steps.summary: The saved comparison opens its full recorded assessment and retains exact result focus.
steps.purpose: Preserve engineering verification and held human review.
steps.action: Reopen the saved comparison and click Open assessment on revision_60_fine.
steps.expected: 25 passed checks and one held review, focused on the requested result.
steps.actual: Exact assessment and fine-result focus retained.

steps.label: Producing engineering step opens
steps.summary: The saved comparison returns to the actual producing step in the accepted process editor.
steps.purpose: Keep the tailored interface and refined editor connected.
steps.action: Reopen the saved comparison and click Open producing step on revision_60_fine.
steps.expected: The accepted heat process editor opens at its producer.
steps.actual: Accepted heat editor opened from the exact result.
